daily_updates.title: Mass Health and Eye Care Camp for Agricultural Laborers Coordinated
daily_updates.description: Specialist doctors conducted free health checks, distributed basic medicines, and supplied free reading glasses to agricultural workers in Kallakurichi outskirts.

daily_updates.title: New RO Clean Drinking Water Plant Opened at Thiyagadurgam Bus Stand
daily_updates.description: A free reverse osmosis water purification station was set up for public use, benefiting thousands of daily commuters and local shopkeepers.

daily_updates.title: High-Mast Solar Streetlights Installation Completed at Chinnasalem
daily_updates.description: Commissioned 15 high-power solar LED streetlights at key pedestrian junctions in Chinnasalem to increase night safety and visibility.

daily_updates.title: Pothole Filling & Road Restoration on Kachirayapalayam Main Road
daily_updates.description: Full restoration and filling of deep potholes along the high-traffic Kachirayapalayam road to guarantee rider safety and smooth local transit.

daily_updates.title: Heavy Rain Relief Materials Distributed in Sankarapuram Wards
daily_updates.description: Essential grocery kits, blankets, and milk supplies were distributed to over 300 families in low-lying Sankarapuram blocks following severe storm water accumulation.

daily_updates.title: Water Logging Cleared at Salem-Ulundurpet National Highway Junction
daily_updates.description: Emergency drainage deployment cleared severe water logging after heavy overnight rainfall, preventing long traffic congestion at the Kallakurichi entry highway.

daily_updates.title: Grand re-opening of Bougainvillea Park
daily_updates.description: MLA Mr. Arul Vignesh along with community members inaugurated the fully renovated Bougainvillea Park, featuring new green lawns, clean walking tracks, and children play facilities.

daily_updates.title: Encroachments Removed from Revamped Anna Nagar Bougainvillea Park Under MLA Mr. Arul Vignesh Initiative
daily_updates.description: Under the active supervision of MLA Mr. Arul Vignesh, key encroachments surrounding the Bougainvillea Park in Anna Nagar were cleared by corporation officials, restoring pedestrian pathways.

daily_updates.title: Swift Action Taken on Public Garbage Complaints.
daily_updates.description: Immediate response to citizens complaints regarding overflowing public waste bins. The entire zone along Bharathipuram Main Road was cleaned and cleared.

daily_updates.title: Garbage Clearance and Sanitation Improvement
daily_updates.description: Under the supervision of local ward authorities, massive garbage mounds at PP Garden were cleared, followed by complete disinfection and street sweeping.

events.title: Anna Nagar Grievance Redressal Town Hall
events.description: Direct town hall meeting with local representatives and officials to file public grievances and inspect ward requirements.
events.venue: Constituency Main Office, Near Central Park

events.title: Welfare Scheme Distribution Drive
events.description: Constituency welfare drive distributing educational scholarships, senior citizen aids, and self-employment packages.

events.title: Ward 5 Tree Plantation & Green City Drive
events.description: Community green initiative aiming to plant 1,000 native tree saplings around the playground. Free saplings for residents.

live_news.title: Public Grievance Redressal Camp: MLA Mr. Arul Vignesh Directs Speedy Action on 200+ Petitions
live_news.content: At the monthly constituency-wide Public Grievance Redressal Camp held at the Central Office, MLA Mr. Arul Vignesh personally met with hundreds of citizens from across all municipal wards and village panchayats.
live_news.author: Desk of Hon'ble MLA Mr. C. Arul Vignesh

live_news.title: Official TVK Youth Welfare and Education Center Inaugurated in Kallakurichi Town
live_news.content: A state-of-the-art TVK Youth Welfare and Education Center was officially inaugurated in Kallakurichi Town to empower students, competitive exam aspirants, and young job seekers from economically weaker sections.
live_news.author: Desk of Hon'ble MLA Mr. C. Arul Vignesh

live_news.title: MLA Mr. Arul Vignesh Inspects Lake Desiltation & Canal Clearing Works at Chinnasalem
live_news.content: To ensure long-term groundwater replenishment and prevent seasonal agricultural flooding, MLA Mr. Arul Vignesh conducted an extensive field inspection of ongoing lake desiltation and irrigation canal widening works in Chinnasalem.
live_news.author: Desk of Hon'ble MLA Mr. C. Arul Vignesh

live_news.title: TVK General Secretary Directs Flood-Relief Volunteering Across Kallakurichi
live_news.content: In response to recent torrential monsoon downpours across northern Tamil Nadu, the General Secretary of Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) has officially directed all district office-bearers and volunteer wings across Kallakurichi to mobilize comprehensive on-ground flood relief measures immediately.
live_news.author: Desk of Hon'ble MLA Mr. C. Arul Vignesh
